info.title: Hotel Underwriting Engine API
info.description: Publish immutable assumption sets and run one scenario synchronously. Runs are content-addressed: the same inputs give the same runKey and the stored result is returned (wasCached true). Authentication depends on the Auth:Mode setting. none (default): no token is needed and the service refuses to listen on anything but loopback (http://127.0.0.1:5080). jwt: every route except /health/* and /openapi/v1.json needs a bearer token (roles claim analyst, reviewer or admin; reviewer may only GET; POST needs analyst or admin), publishing needs the X-Deal-Id header (runs and sweeps need it only when the set belongs to several candidate deals), a new run or job is granted to exactly one deal, and a caller sees only resources of the deals in its deals claim (admin sees all); a resource of another deal answers 404 exactly like a missing one. 401 and 403 occur only in jwt mode. Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json. Sweeps: POST /v1/sweeps queues one base scenario plus many override cases (or a grid) as a durable job processed in chunks of 500 cases by competing workers; poll GET /v1/jobs/{id} and page GET /v1/jobs/{id}/results. Limits: at most 100000 cases, 20 grid axes, 1000 values per axis, 20 overrides per case, case names of at most 100 characters, Idempotency-Key of at most 128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -. Job status: queued (no chunk claimed yet), running, succeeded (all chunks done), failed (any chunk dead after 5 attempts; the other chunks still finish). A case the engine rejects is recorded as that case's error and does not fail the job.

422.description: Body parses but fails engine validation (message in detail) (also duplicate scenario names, no scenarios, more than 20 scenarios, 500 operating lines, 50 percent items or 50 years per vector, a name or code over 100 characters or with control characters, an unknown percent item base, overflow or non-finite cash flows). Rules (each violation is a 422 with a fixed text that names the field and never quotes the rejected value; it may name the scenario and, for the engine's own messages, a number): purchase price above 0; closing costs, placement costs and PIP per key at least 0; fee, cost-of-sale, asset-management, percent-of-revenue, interest and GP share, promote and preferred return rates and loan-to-cost from 0 to 1; exit cap rate above 0 and at most 1; occupancy (every year and the base year) from 0 to 1; ADR growth and expense inflation above -1; base ADR above 0; keys above 0; amortization years above 0; interest-only months at least 0; hold 12-84 months; with a PIP budget the PIP duration and start month are at least 1 and the PIP ends within the hold; scenario names, line codes and percent-item codes are not empty, have no leading or trailing whitespace and are unique; at least one operating line; the year list is strictly ascending; the acquisition date is the 1st of a month at midnight and not so far in the future that the 96-month horizon overflows; no character of Unicode category Cc, Cf (bidi, zero-width, LRM/RLM/ALM, soft hyphen, tag characters), Cs (lone surrogate), Co, Cn, Zl or Zp and no U+034F in any name, code, section, driver or sweep case name; scenario names are unique ignoring case; an operating line's fixed share is from 0 to 1 and its base amount at least 0; percent-of-revenue rates add up to at most 1; cost of sale plus disposition fee at most 1; a refinance rate, refinance fee and hurdle at most 1. A JSON date with an offset is converted to server-local time and may stop being midnight on the 1st: send Z or a plain date

post.description: The body is the .xlsx file itself, at most 10 MB. The package is inspected (at most 500 entries, 50 MB decompressed per entry and 100 MB in total, 50 sheets, 20000 rows per sheet, 200000 cells; no macros, external links, external relationships other than hyperlinks, data connections, query tables, embedded objects or packages, ActiveX or DTDs) and parsed in a child process with memory and time limits. Formulas are never evaluated: the value cached in the file is used. Nothing is stored on disk. The body must arrive within the body time limit (408). The parsed set has the size limits of every published set: 20 scenarios, 500 operating lines, 50 percent-of-revenue items, 50 years per scenario, 100 characters per name or code.

id.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the whole Assumptions. Order-sensitive: the same scenarios in a different order give a different id

monthly.description: Only with include=monthly: monthly schedule arrays, index 0 = acquisition

proforma.description: Only with include=proforma: annual proforma arrays plus lines[{code,name,section,amounts}]

scenarios.description: Names must be unique; at most 20 (more is a 422)

ScenarioInputs.description: holdMonths 12-84; debtEvents are Refinance objects with strictly increasing months in 1..holdMonths-1

ScenarioOverride.description: Sets one numeric ScenarioInputs field. pipStartMonth, pipDurationMonths, interestOnlyMonths and holdMonths need a whole number. Applied in list order, last write wins; vectors, events and tiers are never touched.

SweepRequest.description: Exactly one of cases and grid. A grid expands to the cartesian product (first axis varies slowest) and is never stored expanded. At most 100000 cases and 20 axes.

JobResponse.description: completedCases counts every case with a stored result, failed ones included; failedCases is the subset the engine rejected.

bearerAuth.description: Auth:Mode jwt only. Claims: sub (1 to 128 characters), exp, roles (analyst, reviewer, admin), deals (deal ids).
